title: Threonine dehydrogenase is a minor degradative pathway of threonine catabolism in adult humans
authors: Darling PB, Grunow J, Rafii M, Brookes S, Ball RO, Pencharz PB
journal: American Journal of Physiology. Endocrinology and Metabolism
population: Six healthy adult men studied on a control diet, a diet with added free threonine and a high-protein diet, with 4-hour infusions of L-[1-13C]threonine and [15N]glycine
funder: Medical Research Council (MRC) of Canada Grant MT-12928; P. B. Darling held an MRC studentship.
result: Threonine conversion to glycine, the threonine dehydrogenase pathway, accounted for 10% of total threonine catabolism on the control diet and 7% on both threonine-supplemented diets (7-11% in the abstract); oxidation to CO2 accounted for 90% to 93%.
